newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Inmates stab guard in Austria jail hostage drama.
newsitem.headline: Inmates stab guard in Austria jail hostage drama.

text.p: Two guards were injured, one of them seriously, when inmates took three prison canteen staff hostage at a jail in the southern Austrian town of Graz on Thursday, prison officials said.
The prisoners had strapped explosives to the bodies of the hostages and threatened to kill them if their demands were not met, the Austrian news agency APA reported.
Police were negotiating with three prisoners over their demand for a ransom for the hostages and a getaway helicopter.
"The police are out there negotiating with the hostage-takers," a prison official told Reuters. "I believe one of the guards has been seriously injured."
APA said one of the guards had been stabbed with a knife during the incident. He and the other injured prison warder were taken to hospital by helicopter.
Two of the hostage-takers were convicted murderers and one was serving a long jail sentence for armed robbery, the agency added.
